description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionManager component in a macOS application, verifying permission statuses and behavior for various capabilities such as voice wake, location, microphone, speech recognition, and screen recording.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for verifying PermissionManager behaviors related to permissions and authorization statuses.

methods.name: voice wake permission helpers match status
methods.description: Tests whether the permission helper correctly reports granted voice wake permissions.

methods.name: status can query non interactive caps
methods.description: Verifies that permission status can be queried for a set of capabilities non-interactively.

methods.name: ensure non interactive does not throw
methods.description: Checks that ensuring permissions for capabilities non-interactively does not raise exceptions.

methods.name: location status matches authorization always
methods.description: Ensures that the permission status reflects CLLocationManager's authorization status for location.

methods.name: ensure location non interactive matches authorization always
methods.description: Verifies that ensuring location permission non-interactively aligns with CLLocationManager's authorization status.
